Search public records for <FULL NAME>, born around <YEAR> in <PLACE>, child of <FATHER> and <MOTHER>.
REQUIRED RULES:
1) Only include someone under CONFIRMED if you opened a record with NAME + DATE + PLACE, and give me the DIRECT LINK to the record and the collection name.
2) Say which information in the record connects the person to my family (parents, spouse, address). A matching last name is NOT a connection.
3) Put assumptions on a separate list, HYPOTHESES, with the reason and the document that would confirm them.
4) If you find nothing, answer "I couldn't find anything." I prefer that to an invented name.
5) Don't fill in dates or places that aren't in the record.
